body: @ChMThiel would you like to contribute a fix for this?
I agree it should be fixed. Looking forward to your contribution!

I think we should probably go for the easiest way meaning storing the header names as lower case and getting them as lowercase too.
We should add a Javadoc to `AbstractLocaleResolver#getHeaders()` to make it clear.

issue.title: Make accept header check in validation case insensitive
